## Scope

This report checks the final Parquet file's schema, completeness, county codes,
duplicate keys, outage-to-granule time overlap, local-time selection, and
selected numeric values. Checks are descriptive; review flags do not modify the
dataset.

The report reads the existing Parquet file; it does not rebuild it. Run
`make` before rendering after changing preprocessing logic.

The local-time check uses the generated county time-zone lookup tables when
available. The current Parquet schema does not retain `tzid`, so the report
reconstructs it from those lookup files.

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)

data_candidates <- c(
  "outages-with-viirs-image.parquet",
  "../outages-with-viirs-image.parquet"
)
dataset_path <- data_candidates[file.exists(data_candidates)][1]
if (is.na(dataset_path)) {
  stop("Could not find outages-with-viirs-image.parquet in the repository root.")
}

raw_data <- arrow::read_parquet(dataset_path) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
fields <- names(raw_data)
data <- raw_data |>
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(eaglei_outage_time_utc))

lookup_dir <- if (dir.exists("data/processed")) {
  "data/processed"
} else {
  "../data/processed"
}
file_size_mb <- round(file.info(dataset_path)$size / 1024^2, 1)
```

## Dataset overview

```{r}
overview <- tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "File",
    "File size",
    "Rows",
    "Columns",
    "County FIPS codes",
    "FIPS state/territory prefixes",
    "VIIRS granule IDs",
    "Earliest Eagle-I time (UTC)",
    "Latest Eagle-I time (UTC)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    basename(dataset_path),
    paste(file_size_mb, "MiB"),
    format(nrow(data), big.mark = ","),
    length(fields),
    format(n_distinct(data$fips_code), big.mark = ","),
    format(n_distinct(substr(data$fips_code, 1, 2)), big.mark = ","),
    format(n_distinct(data$viirs_id), big.mark = ","),
    format(min(data$eaglei_outage_time_utc), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC", tz = "UTC"),
    format(max(data$eaglei_outage_time_utc), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC", tz = "UTC")
  )
)

knitr::kable(overview, col.names = c("Measure", "Value"))
```

### Rows by year

```{r}
year_counts <- data |>
  count(year, name = "rows") |>
  arrange(year)

ggplot(year_counts, aes(x = factor(year), y = rows)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2878A0") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "Eagle-I year (UTC)", y = "Rows", title = "Final records by year") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Completeness and schema

```{r}
field_types <- vapply(
  raw_data,
  function(x) {
    if (inherits(x, "POSIXct")) {
      "timestamp"
    } else if (is.character(x)) {
      "string"
    } else if (is.numeric(x)) {
      "numeric"
    } else {
      paste(class(x), collapse = "/")
    }
  },
  character(1)
)

missingness <- tibble(
  field = fields,
  type = unname(field_types),
  missing = vapply(raw_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)), integer(1))
) |>
  mutate(percent_missing = 100 * missing / nrow(raw_data))

knitr::kable(
  missingness,
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c("Field", "Type", "Missing rows", "Missing (%)")
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(missingness, aes(x = reorder(field, percent_missing), y = percent_missing)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#C47A28") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Missing rows (%)", title = "Field completeness") +
  theme_minimal()
```

`total_customers` contains only values provided by the raw Eagle-I files; it
is not filled from coverage estimates. `est_total_customers` is a separate
estimate allocated from state coverage totals using ACS county household
shares, with 2022 totals carried forward to estimate 2023–2024. Connecticut
uses 2021 ACS county estimates from the last vintage with its former county
geography. U.S. Virgin Islands records (FIPS prefix `78`) are excluded.
Missing `total_customers` values are expected when the raw file does not
provide them.

## Integrity checks

```{r}
expected_fields <- c(
  "fips_code",
  "eaglei_outage_time_utc",
  "viirs_id",
  "viirs_pass_start_time_utc",
  "viirs_pass_end_time_utc",
  "total_customers",
  "est_total_customers",
  "customers_out",
  "customers_out_8hr_prior"
)
missing_fields <- setdiff(expected_fields, fields)
key_fields <- c(
  "fips_code",
  "eaglei_outage_time_utc",
  "viirs_id",
  "viirs_pass_start_time_utc",
  "viirs_pass_end_time_utc"
)

bad_fips <- sum(
  is.na(data$fips_code) | !grepl("^[0-9]{5}$", data$fips_code)
)
vi_fips_rows <- sum(grepl("^78", data$fips_code), na.rm = TRUE)
ct_legacy_fips <- c(
  "09001", "09003", "09005", "09007",
  "09009", "09011", "09013", "09015"
)
ct_missing_estimates <- sum(
  data$year >= 2022 &
    data$fips_code %in% ct_legacy_fips &
    is.na(data$est_total_customers)
)
duplicate_key_rows <- nrow(data) -
  nrow(distinct(data, across(all_of(key_fields))))
bad_pass_durations <- sum(
  data$viirs_pass_end_time_utc <= data$viirs_pass_start_time_utc,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
bad_overlaps <- sum(
  data$eaglei_outage_time_utc > data$viirs_pass_end_time_utc |
    data$eaglei_outage_time_utc + minutes(15) < data$viirs_pass_start_time_utc,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

numeric_fields <- c(
  "total_customers",
  "est_total_customers",
  "customers_out",
  "customers_out_8hr_prior"
)
negative_values <- sum(vapply(
  numeric_fields,
  function(field) sum(data[[field]] < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  integer(1)
))
customers_over_estimate <- sum(
  data$customers_out > data$est_total_customers,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

years <- sort(unique(data$year))
lookup_files <- file.path(lookup_dir, paste0("tz_lookup_", years, ".csv"))
timezone_missing <- NA_integer_
local_hour_violations <- NA_integer_
timezone_check_status <- "SKIP"
timezone_check_result <- "Annual time-zone lookup CSVs are unavailable."

if ("tzid" %in% fields) {
  local_data <- data
  timezone_missing <- sum(is.na(local_data$tzid))
  local_data <- local_data |>
    filter(!is.na(tzid)) |>
    group_by(tzid) |>
    mutate(local_hour = hour(with_tz(eaglei_outage_time_utc, first(tzid)))) |>
    ungroup()
  local_hour_violations <- sum(!local_data$local_hour %in% 0:2, na.rm = TRUE)
  timezone_check_status <- if (timezone_missing == 0L &&
    local_hour_violations == 0L) "PASS" else "REVIEW"
  timezone_check_result <- paste(
    timezone_missing, "missing time zones;",
    local_hour_violations, "rows outside local hours 00:00–02:45"
  )
} else if (all(file.exists(lookup_files))) {
  timezone_lookup <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(lookup_files), function(i) {
    readr::read_csv(
      lookup_files[[i]],
      col_types = cols(
        fips_code = col_character(),
        tzid = col_character()
      ),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ) |>
      mutate(year = years[[i]])
  }))

  local_data <- left_join(data, timezone_lookup, by = c("fips_code", "year"))
  timezone_missing <- sum(is.na(local_data$tzid))
  local_data <- local_data |>
    filter(!is.na(tzid)) |>
    group_by(tzid) |>
    mutate(local_hour = hour(with_tz(eaglei_outage_time_utc, first(tzid)))) |>
    ungroup()
  local_hour_violations <- sum(!local_data$local_hour %in% 0:2, na.rm = TRUE)
  timezone_check_status <- if (timezone_missing == 0L &&
    local_hour_violations == 0L) "PASS" else "REVIEW"
  timezone_check_result <- paste(
    timezone_missing, "missing time-zone matches;",
    local_hour_violations, "rows outside local hours 00:00–02:45"
  )
}

checks <- tibble(
  Check = c(
    "Expected fields present",
    "County FIPS has five digits",
    "U.S. Virgin Islands excluded",
    "CT legacy-county estimates present",
    "Composite row key is unique",
    "VIIRS pass end follows pass start",
    "15-minute outage interval overlaps VIIRS pass",
    "County time zone and local-hour filter",
    "Nonnegative customer counts",
    "customers_out does not exceed county estimate"
  ),
  Status = c(
    if (length(missing_fields) == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL",
    if (bad_fips == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL",
    if (vi_fips_rows == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL",
    if (ct_missing_estimates == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL",
    if (duplicate_key_rows == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL",
    if (bad_pass_durations == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL",
    if (bad_overlaps == 0) "PASS" else "FAIL",
    timezone_check_status,
    if (negative_values == 0) "PASS" else "REVIEW",
    if (customers_over_estimate == 0) "PASS" else "REVIEW"
  ),
  Result = c(
    if (length(missing_fields) == 0) {
      paste(length(expected_fields), "expected fields present")
    } else {
      paste("Missing:", paste(missing_fields, collapse = ", "))
    },
    paste(bad_fips, "invalid codes"),
    paste(vi_fips_rows, "Virgin Islands rows"),
    paste(ct_missing_estimates, "post-2021 CT legacy-county estimates missing"),
    paste(duplicate_key_rows, "duplicate rows"),
    paste(bad_pass_durations, "invalid durations"),
    paste(bad_overlaps, "non-overlapping intervals"),
    timezone_check_result,
    paste(negative_values, "negative values"),
    paste(
      format(customers_over_estimate, big.mark = ","),
      "rows exceed the ACS-based county estimate"
    )
  )
)

knitr::kable(checks)
```

`customers_out` exceeding `est_total_customers` is flagged for review, not
treated as an automatic failure: the county customer estimate is allocated
from state totals using ACS household shares.

## Numeric summaries

```{r}
numeric_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(numeric_fields, function(field) {
  values <- data[[field]]
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  tibble(
    field = field,
    n = length(values),
    minimum = if (length(values)) min(values) else NA_real_,
    median = if (length(values)) median(values) else NA_real_,
    p95 = if (length(values)) unname(quantile(values, 0.95)) else NA_real_,
    maximum = if (length(values)) max(values) else NA_real_
  )
}))

knitr::kable(
  numeric_summary,
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c("Field", "Nonmissing values", "Minimum", "Median", "95th percentile", "Maximum")
)
```
